dedupe_keys.name: unctad sdg pulse 2025 trade in critical minerals 60 mineral list mapped to hs codes

description: This chapter of UNCTAD SDG Pulse 2025 analyses world trade in critical minerals using a list of 60 critical minerals mapped to 499 six-digit Harmonized System codes, defined by their role in the energy transition, digital transformation and industrial development. It reports that trade in raw and semi-processed minerals reached about 2.57 trillion dollars of imports and 2.52 trillion of exports in 2023, over 10% of world exports, with Asia the largest importer at 1.5 trillion, and that minerals needed for the energy transition drove 773 billion dollars of exports. It also shows bilateral dependencies, top exported minerals, gaps between top producers and exporters, regional specialisation, export restrictions from 2019 to 2023 and national approaches to criticality. It is published by UN Trade and Development with data from the UN Comtrade Database. Coverage is global, by country and region. The chapter and charts are available free online, with PDF editions of SDG Pulse; the page read gives no licence. Caveats: it is an analysis, not a downloadable table, results depend on the HS mapping, and values are trade, not production. For simulation it gives a mineral-to-HS mapping and dependency indicators for trade network models of how export restrictions or disruptions in one country ripple to energy and manufacturing supply chains. It is related to the UN Comtrade record in this catalogue, its data source.
